name: Steinadler
beschreibung:
The Steinadler apartment is situated in a traditional Tyrolean village in the Ötztal valley. The property seamlessly blends regional alpine architecture with modern comforts. Guests stay in spacious apartments featuring solid wood furnishings and a balcony overlooking the majestic mountain panorama.

The ground floor features a small wellness area with a sauna and relaxation room, while a covered outdoor terrace invites guests to unwind.
